criteria.criterion: Cumulative attribution by measurement: per-section elapsed time was summed against the 240s budget, naming the consuming sections and accounting for existing per-call bounds.

The reserve is enforced by an absolute deadline, not by reservation: the probe records PROBE_STARTED_AT; probe_budget_left computes PROBE_DEADLINE_SEC - elapsed - PROBE_TAIL_RESERVE_SEC; every wall-clock-bounded call receives min(own ceiling, budget_left) floored at 1s.
Verified by asserting the GRANT each call receives: exhausted budget gives the 1s floor; full budget gives the call's own ceiling.
Every bounded call routes through the one clamped helper; the source-scan guard fails if a call site bypasses it.
The clamped portion is bounded by construction at PROBE_DEADLINE_SEC - PROBE_TAIL_RESERVE_SEC = 160s, leaving an 80s tail margin under the 240s unit timeout.
PROBE_DEADLINE_SEC equals the unit's TimeoutStartSec, enforced by tests against install-observability.sh.

A truncated run cannot be silent: ExecStopPost --report-exit publishes/logs probe_truncated; normal completion publishes probe_ok and probe_elapsed_seconds at the end.
The truncation signal needs no network call in the normal path: the report hook reads cached region first and logs to journald even if metric publication cannot happen.
Defect-seeded: tests drive calls past the whole budget; late metrics still get their turn and the completion signal fires.
